title: Duct installation.
officialText: Exhaust ducts shall be supported at 4-foot (1219 mm) intervals and secured in place. The inserted end of the duct shall extend into the adjoining duct or fitting in the direction of airflow. Ducts shall not be joined with screws or similar fasteners that protrude into the inside of the duct.
